about.title: A childhood computer adventure with a darker signal
about.lead: Endacopia is a surreal point-and-click puzzle adventure presented through Mellow, a lost boy guided by the player as his Guardian Angel.
about.description: Its early-computer edutainment look hides abstract puzzles, unsettling characters, first-person fights, optional minigames, collectible tools, and secrets that reward careful exploration.
features: Explore major areas in a flexible order

items.description: The community route identifies one hidden encounter in each of Misery Town, Timesville and the Office. Check the encounter, not just the item.

items.title: How do I get the fishing key?
items.description: Find the Fishing Paper with the Metal Detector, catch the 18 fish across the six clock states and inspect the completed paper to claim the Old or Lost Key.
items.label: Open the fish and key guide

items.title: Where do I use the Lost Key?
items.description: In the Timesville secret, complete the paired-room puzzle and switch to windowed mode to reveal the hidden lock. The Office Core Key is a separate item.
items.label: Find the lock
